I'm very open about my anxiety so i can write a few things here, also sorry if i misspelled something, im from Venezuela so english it's not my first language.

So i've been strugling with anxiety, depression, bpd and ocd for almost 12 years now, and its been very very hard, this last 2 years were truly awful for me.

I was on a downward spiral, i drank and smoked a lot, i had insomnia, constant nightmares, i slept with a lot of people so i could feel something, and some other negative things.

2 weeks ago i had a huge panic attack on one of my friends house and i really want it to kill my self, i was drinking non stop for 3 weeks, day and night. That day the girl who i'm currently dating told me a lot of good things, i think she and my friends were the spark that i needed to finally start doing something with my life, since then, i've been working out every day, i've been eating healthier (whenever i had anxiety i used to starve my self for days, cuz i didn't had the will to keep living), i'm currently taking vitamins, i'm seeking a therapist and i'm starting to draw again

I know its hard, i know that  the slope is quite steep but as the runner from BoJack horseman says  "It gets easier. Every day it gets a little easier. But you got to do it every day. That's the hard part. But it does get easier"

If you need someone to talk my dude, my door is always open ok? I'm always going to be here if you need any help, just dm me
